title: Inspect a local file envelope
summary: Identify and characterize one local file before a downstream tool acts, while preserving uncertainty, routing traits, integrity, and probe evidence.

operations.title: Inspect file
operations.description: Read one regular file inside an explicitly granted workspace and return bounded identity, integrity, routing, structured-data, image, diagnostics, provenance, and enforced-limit facts. Signature evidence outranks the filename extension. The operation does not extract document content, transform the file, or authorize a downstream action.

errors.description: The request shape or inspection option is outside the portable contract.
The named file does not exist inside the granted workspace.
The path is absolute, traverses outside the grant, is URI-like, contains a symlink, or is not a regular file.
The inspection exceeded a declared time, memory, input, or response limit.
The provider could not safely complete the inspection.
